steps.title: Do not send any more gift cards
steps.detail: Even if they call again, cry, or say it's an emergency, do not buy or send another card. Stop replying to them.

steps.title: Call the gift card company right now
steps.detail: Look at the back of the gift card or your receipt for the company's phone number, or go to the company's official website. Tell them the card was used in a scam and ask them to freeze the money. The faster you call, the better the chance.

steps.title: Keep the card and the receipt
steps.detail: Do not throw away the card, its packaging, or the store receipt. The card number and receipt are what the company needs to try to freeze the money.

steps.title: Call your grandchild on the number you already have
steps.detail: Use the number saved in your phone, not any number from the message. You can also call their mom or dad. This will almost surely show they are safe and not in jail.

steps.title: Report it to the FTC

steps.title: Report it to the FBI

steps.title: Watch for a second trick
